question.text: In a Young's double slit experiment <math><mn>15</mn></math> fringes are observed on a small portion of the screen when light of wavelength <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>500</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> is used. Ten fringes are observed on the same section of the screen when another light source of wavelength <math><mi>λ</mi></math> is used. Then the value of <math><mi>λ</mi></math> is (in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> ) __________.
